## Perplexity Computer Workflow Automation in Action

Perplexity Computer workflow automation transforms chaos into order. Input a goal like “Launch a product site.” It plans steps: research competitors, wireframe UI, code backend, integrate payments, deploy to Vercel.

Sub-agents collaborate asynchronously. Dependencies resolve automatically. Errors trigger fixes. [...] CEO Aravind Srinivas calls it the “next big thing” after two months of quiet development. Files, tools, memory, and models unite seamlessly. Users describe outcomes; the system delivers.

Consider this: AI agents now manage 40% more workflows than in 2025, per recent industry analysis. Perplexity Computer leads that charge. It feels personal. It remembers your past projects.

# Perplexity AI Launches ‘Perplexity Computer’ to Automate Workflows

Perplexity Computer

Perplexity AI unveiled Perplexity Computer , a breakthrough system that orchestrates 19 AI models to handle research, coding, design, deployment, and project management end-to-end. This launch marks a pivotal shift for the company from AI search to full Perplexity Computer workflow automation. You now command agents that run autonomously for hours or months.

## What Makes Perplexity Computer a Game-Changer?

Perplexity Computer redefines how we work. It breaks high-level goals into tasks. Sub-agents execute them in parallel.
